notes.title: Small Update! Fixed voice chat issues, added host indicator, optimizations!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, this update should fix most of the issues people were having with the game! 

Patch notes:

 Fixed UI bug when players join mid game.
 Fixed talking through walls.
 Minor optimizations for low framerates.
 Added host indicator (displayed in the top right of your screen)
 Fixed mac users not being able to access host options (for mac use Tab instead of caps lock)
 Fixed voice chat not working for some users (hopefully, I wasn't able to replicate it on my end, but 
 I made some changes that should solve the problems)


Hope everyone is doing well, and let me know what your suggestions/bug reports are below!
